Join the team driving Zero-Impact Breach Prevention

At Mitiga, every role connects to a clear mission: stopping attackers before they cause impact. We’re building the first platform designed to protect Cloud, SaaS, AI, and Identity with real-time detection, investigation, and response.If you want to advance your career while shaping the future of cybersecurity, Mitiga is where you can do it.

View Open Positions

The Mitiga team

We put people first. That principle drives how we build technology, serve customers, and grow as a company. We hire people who bring curiosity, skill, and perspective. And we give them the space to do their best work.

Our culture

Mitigans are diverse and globally based, with one thing in common: passion for building resilience against modern cyber threats. We learn fast, challenge conventions, and share wins as a team.

Our Values

01

Own our customers’ success

We treat our customer's mission as our own, taking full ownership to achieve zero impact, no matter what.

02

Be responsive and attentive

We’re always present, listening actively, spotting what others miss, and responding with clarity and speed.

03

Act with urgency and speed

We treat time as a strategic advantage. We move faster than the attackers to protect our customers and prevent impact.

04

Win as one team

We succeed together, empowering each other to deliver excellence, resilience, and results that matter.

05

Innovate and improve constantly

We never stand still, relentlessly innovating for smarter, faster ways to defend our customers and outpace attackers.

06

Demonstrate world-class expertise, always

Our customers rely on us to lead. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering insight, direction, and real results.
